title: IR 64 Parboiled Rice Export to Italy | Patel Impex
h1: IR 64 Parboiled Rice Export to Italy
description: IR 64 Parboiled Rice export from India to Italy by Patel Impex - specification, grades, packing, certification, documentation and 16 - 22 days transit to Geno
html:
Patel Impex supplies IR 64 Parboiled Rice from Veraval (Shapar), Rajkot, Gujarat to importers, distributors, repackers and food manufacturers across Italy. We buy at the source in India's producing belts, process and pack to the specification the buyer signs off, and ship through Mundra and Kandla so every container leaves with the same documentation set and the same quality file.

This page covers everything a buyer in Italy needs before placing an order: technical specification, available grades, packing formats, quality controls, the paperwork customs will ask for, realistic transit times and the factors that move the price. If your requirement sits outside what is listed, send us the specification and we will quote against it.

Why buyers in Italy source IR 64 Parboiled Rice from India

India is the volume origin for rice of this type, and that scale is what keeps pricing workable for a Italy importer buying container loads rather than pallets. Three things matter in practice:

  • Consistent origin. We work with the same growing regions and processing partners season after season, so the lot you approve in March behaves like the lot you receive in September.
  • Specification control. Cleaning, grading, sortex, sieving and (where relevant) steam sterilisation are set to the destination's limits before packing, not corrected afterwards.
  • Documented traceability. Every bag carries a lot code that ties back to intake, processing date, test results and the container it shipped in - what a Italy audit or recall drill will ask for.
  • One counterpart. Sourcing, processing, packing, inspection, freight booking and documentation sit with one team, so there is no gap between the supplier and the forwarder.

IR 64 Parboiled Rice technical specification

Broken grains5% / 25% / 100% options
Moisture14% max
Grain length6.20 mm - 6.60 mm
Chalky grains3% max
Damaged grains2% max
CropCurrent season
HS code1006.30
Shelf life18 months
Loading portMundra / Kandla, Gujarat, India

Values above are the standard export specification. Tighter tolerances are available on contract - buyers supplying industrial bakeries, spice blenders and pharmaceutical customers in Italy routinely ask us to hold a narrower moisture or mesh band, and we quote that as a distinct grade rather than shipping against a general specification.

Grades we ship to Italy

  • 5% broken
  • 25% broken
  • 100% broken

If your Italy customers sit across more than one price point, we can run two or three grades in the same container with separate lot codes and separate certificates of analysis, so retail and food-service volumes move on one bill of lading.

Packing and container loading

  • PP bags 25 / 50 kg
  • Jumbo bags 1000 kg
  • Bulk in liner-fitted containers

Standard export packing is palletised and stretch-wrapped, with desiccant and container liners on request for the humidity a Genoa / Gioia Tauro discharge can involve. A 20 ft container carries roughly 18 - 20 MT in bags; a 40 ft high cube is used where volume rather than weight is the constraint, which is common for bulky or light-density lines. Palletised loading is available where your Italy warehouse handles forklifts only.

Quality control and certification

Quality is checked three times: at intake, in process and after packing. Raw material is rejected at intake if moisture or foreign matter is out of band - it is far cheaper than reworking a finished lot. Finished goods are tested for the parameters listed above plus microbiology and pesticide residues where the commodity and destination require it, and a certificate of analysis travels with every shipment.

We operate to FSSAI registration in India and support APEDA and Spices Board documentation, ISO 22000 and HACCP-aligned processing partners, halal and kosher certification on request, and organic certification for the lines where it is offered. Third-party pre-shipment inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas or Intertek can be arranged and is billed at cost.

Export documentation for Italy

EU health documentation and Italian-language commercial labels. Alongside destination paperwork, each shipment carries the commercial invoice, packing list with lot-level detail, bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate where applicable, fumigation certificate where the packing requires it, insurance certificate on CIF terms and the certificate of analysis. We send the full draft set for your approval before the originals are couriered, which is the simplest way to avoid a demurrage bill at Genoa / Gioia Tauro.

Shipping and lead time

Production and quality clearance take about 5 - 7 working days for stock grades and 10 - 15 days where a custom specification or printed private-label packing is involved. Sea transit from Mundra or Kandla to Genoa / Gioia Tauro is typically 16 - 22 days on direct services, longer where the routing transships. Air freight is practical for samples and for pharma-grade or high-value spice lots. We quote FOB, CFR and CIF, and can work with your nominated forwarder in Italy if you prefer to control the freight leg yourself.

What moves the price

Four things: the crop position in the producing belt, the grade and tolerance you specify, the packing format, and the freight rate on the India - Italy lane at the time of booking. Because these move independently, our quotes are valid for a defined window and state the grade, packing, Incoterm and payment terms explicitly. For programme buyers we hold seasonal contracts that fix the specification and the price band for an agreed volume, which removes most of the volatility from your landed cost.

How to order

Send us the product, grade, quantity, packing and delivery port. We reply with a written quotation, a specification sheet and a sample dispatch where you need one. Once the specification is approved we confirm the contract, produce, inspect, stuff and ship - with progress updates at each stage and full document scans before the vessel sails. Contact Patel Impex or call +91 99748 73171 to start.

Frequently asked questions

What is the minimum order quantity for IR 64 Parboiled Rice to Italy?

For bagged consignments we start at one 20 ft container, which typically holds 18 - 20 MT of ir 64 parboiled rice depending on the packing you choose. Buyers in Italy testing a new label often begin with a mixed container combining ir 64 parboiled rice with another Patel Impex line to keep freight cost per kilo low.

Which documents travel with a IR 64 Parboiled Rice shipment to Italy?

Every consignment leaves Gujarat with a commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate where the commodity requires one, a third-party certificate of analysis and any Italy-specific paperwork. EU health documentation and Italian-language commercial labels.

How long does shipping take from India to Italy?

Transit from Mundra or Kandla to Genoa / Gioia Tauro runs about 16 - 22 days on direct services, plus roughly 5 - 7 working days for production, quality clearance, stuffing and documentation before the vessel sails.

Can we buy under our own brand?

Yes. We handle private-label ir 64 parboiled rice with buyer artwork, destination-compliant declarations, barcodes and batch coding. Artwork is proofed and approved digitally before any print run starts.

What payment terms do you offer?

We work on advance TT, irrevocable letter of credit at sight and, for repeat buyers with an established track record, documents against payment. Terms are quoted per contract along with FOB, CFR or CIF pricing.

How is quality verified before shipment?

Each lot is sampled at intake and again after packing. We test moisture, foreign matter, microbiology and pesticide residues against the limits that apply in Italy, and we are happy to appoint SGS, Bureau Veritas or Intertek for pre-shipment inspection at the buyer's request.
